author: Flick Connection
description:
If you’ve ever wondered “Is Peacock worth it?” Here’s a complete breakdown of the Peacock streaming service in 2026.

As someone who subscribes to nearly every major platform, I’ve been using Peacock for almost 2 years… and in this video, I’ll walk you through exactly what you get, how much it costs, and whether it’s actually worth your money.

Peacock can be a great value… but only if you’re using it the right way and getting the best deal. If you’re mainly looking for movies, or comparing Peacock vs Netflix, there are some important things you need to know before subscribing.

This is a no-nonsense Peacock review based on real usage.
